title: A Lagrangian superposition principle for the continuity equation with reaction
summary: We study the continuity equation with reaction $\partial_tμ+ \operatorname{div}(vμ) = wμ$ on $[0,T]\times\mathbb{R}^d$, driven by Borel velocity and reaction fields $v$ and $w$. We provide the first version of a Lagrangian superposition principle for the equation in its natural generality, assuming only finite quadratic energy without imposing boundedness conditions on the reaction term neither any form of compactness for the support of the measure.
